Elite Fitness Gym

Transform Your Body, Transform Your Life

State-of-the-art equipment, expert trainers, and a community dedicated to your success

View Membership Plans

  • Sauna & Steam Room

Choose Your Membership Plan

Select the plan that fits your fitness goals and lifestyle. All memberships include access to all facilities and classes.

Plan Monthly Price Annual Savings Personal Training Guest Passes Access Hours

Plan Details

Starter Plan

$29/month

Perfect for beginners and those testing the fitness lifestyle.

  • Access to all gym equipment
  • Group fitness classes
  • Mobile app with workout tracking
  • Community access

Standard Plan

$49/month

Great for committed fitness enthusiasts wanting personalized guidance.

  • Everything in Starter
  • 4 Personal Training sessions/month
  • 2 guest passes per month
  • Nutrition consultation quarterly
Most Popular

Premium Plan

$79/month

Our most comprehensive option with unlimited access and expert support.

  • Everything in Standard
  • 8 Personal Training sessions/month
  • Unlimited guest passes
  • 24/7 gym access
  • Priority class booking
  • Monthly body composition analysis

Elite Plan

$129/month

For serious athletes and those seeking maximum results and attention.

  • Everything in Premium
  • Unlimited Personal Training
  • Dedicated fitness coach
  • Customized meal planning
  • VIP locker + premium amenities
  • Priority access to new equipment
